faq.q: What does the Agricultural Area Plan cover?
faq.a: The plan covers the western rural and agricultural land of the City of Chilliwack, where the farm sector is dominated by dairy and poultry operations, nurseries and greenhouses; it is a schedule of the Official Community Plan.

faq.q: Can Jared show me homes in West Chilliwack?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: How do I find out what my home in West Chilliwack is worth?
faq.a: Jared prepares a home evaluation from recent comparable sales and the condition of your home. Contact him on 604-928-1361 or through the form on this site to arrange one.
